title: Write a PRD and User Stories
description: Create a Product Requirements Document with user stories and acceptance criteria for a student attendance tracker
objective: Students will write a complete PRD with user personas, user stories, MoSCoW prioritization, and acceptance criteria for a real-world Indian-context product

steps.title: Define the Problem Statement
steps.instructions:
Create a new folder on your computer called `attendance-tracker-spec`.

Inside it, create a file called `PRD.md`.

Write the **Problem Statement** section:

```markdown
# PRD: SmartAttend — Student Attendance Tracker

## Problem Statement

At TechPath Institute, Bhopal, attendance is tracked using paper registers.
This causes the following problems:

1. Trainers waste 10 minutes per class taking attendance manually
2. Students don't know their attendance percentage until exam registration
3. Admin staff spend 2 hours per month calculating percentages in Excel
4. Paper registers get lost — last month, Batch PFS-July register was misplaced
5. No way to alert students when attendance drops below 75%
```

Now add a **Stakeholder Pain Points** table:

| Stakeholder | Pain Point |
|-------------|------------|
| Trainers | Wasting 10 min per class on paper attendance |
| Students | No real-time visibility into attendance % |
| Admin | Manual Excel work every month |
| Institute Director | Cannot make data-driven decisions about batches |

Save the file.

steps.title: Create User Personas
steps.instructions:
Add a **User Personas** section to your `PRD.md`:

```markdown
## User Personas

### Persona 1: Amit Kumar (Trainer)
- **Age:** 32
- **Location:** Bhopal
- **Tech Comfort:** Moderate — uses WhatsApp, Gmail, basic Excel
- **Goal:** Mark attendance for 30 students in under 2 minutes
- **Frustration:** "I spend the first 10 minutes of every class calling names. By the time I start teaching, students are already distracted."
- **Device:** Laptop (in class), Android phone (everywhere else)

### Persona 2: Priya Patel (Student)
- **Age:** 21
- **Location:** Pune (attending online batch)
- **Tech Comfort:** High — uses apps daily, comfortable with web tools
- **Goal:** Check attendance anytime from her phone
- **Frustration:** "I found out my attendance was 72% only when I tried to register for the exam. If I had known earlier, I would have attended more classes."
- **Device:** Android phone (primary), laptop (for coding)
```

Write one more persona for an **Admin** role. Give them an Indian name, specific frustrations, and realistic details.

steps.title: Write User Stories with MoSCoW Prioritization
steps.instructions:
Add a **User Stories** section to your `PRD.md`.

Write at least 10 user stories following this format:
**As a [user type], I want to [action] so that [benefit].**

Organize them using MoSCoW prioritization:

```markdown
## User Stories

### Must Have (MVP)
| ID | User Story | Priority |
|----|-----------|----------|
| US-01 | As a trainer, I want to mark attendance for my batch so that records are digital and searchable | Must Have |
| US-02 | As a student, I want to view my attendance percentage so that I can track my exam eligibility | Must Have |
| US-03 | As an admin, I want to log in with email/password so that only authorized users access the system | Must Have |
| US-04 | As a trainer, I want to see a list of students in my batch so that I can mark attendance quickly | Must Have |

### Should Have
| US-05 | As an admin, I want to download attendance as Excel so that I can share reports with management | Should Have |
| US-06 | As a trainer, I want to edit past attendance records so that I can fix mistakes | Should Have |

### Could Have
| US-07 | As a student, I want to receive an email alert when my attendance drops below 75% | Could Have |

### Won't Have (This Version)
| US-08 | Mobile native app (Android/iOS) | Won't Have — web app is sufficient for v1 |
```

Add at least 3 more user stories of your own. Make sure each one follows the correct format and has a clear benefit.

steps.title: Write Acceptance Criteria
steps.instructions:
Add **Acceptance Criteria** for at least 3 user stories using GIVEN/WHEN/THEN format:

```markdown
## Acceptance Criteria

### US-01: Trainer marks attendance

```
GIVEN the trainer is logged in
AND has selected batch "PFS-2026-July"
WHEN they open the attendance page for today (2026-07-25)
THEN they see a list of all 30 students in the batch
AND each student has a toggle: Present / Absent
AND there is a "Submit Attendance" button
AND after clicking Submit, they see "Attendance marked for 30 students"
AND the attendance cannot be submitted again for the same date (prevents duplicates)
AND future dates are disabled
```

### US-02: Student views attendance

```
GIVEN the student "Priya Patel" is logged in
WHEN she opens the "My Attendance" page
THEN she sees her overall attendance percentage (e.g., 85%)
AND she sees a monthly calendar with green (present) and red (absent) dots
AND she can filter by month using a dropdown
AND the page loads within 2 seconds
AND if she has no records yet, she sees "No attendance records found"
```
```

Now write acceptance criteria for one more user story of your choice. Be specific — mention exact numbers, error messages, and edge cases.

steps.title: Add Non-Functional Requirements and Timeline
steps.instructions:
Complete your PRD with two final sections:

**Non-Functional Requirements:**

```markdown
## Non-Functional Requirements

| Category | Requirement | Target |
|----------|------------|--------|
| Performance | Page load time | Under 2 seconds on 4G |
| Performance | API response time | Under 500ms |
| Security | Passwords | Hashed with bcrypt |
| Security | API authentication | JWT tokens, 60-min expiry |
| Security | Transport | HTTPS in production |
| Compatibility | Browsers | Chrome 90+, Firefox 90+, Edge 90+ |
| Compatibility | Devices | Responsive — mobile, tablet, desktop |
| Availability | Uptime target | 99.5% |
```

**6-Week Timeline:**

```markdown
## Timeline

| Week | Focus | Deliverables |
|------|-------|--------------|
| 1 | Setup | Repo, DB schema, auth, CI/CD |
| 2 | Core Backend | Student CRUD, attendance API |
| 3 | Frontend — Trainer | Mark attendance page |
| 4 | Frontend — Student | View attendance, calendar |
| 5 | AI Feature + Reports | Chatbot, Excel export |
| 6 | Deploy + Polish | Production deploy, bug fixes, demo |
```

Review your complete PRD. Does every section have specific, measurable details? Does it answer: **What are we building, for whom, and why?**

Save the final `PRD.md` and verify it renders properly in VS Code's Markdown preview (Ctrl+Shift+V).

expected_output: A complete PRD.md file with problem statement, 2-3 user personas, 10+ user stories with MoSCoW prioritization, acceptance criteria in GIVEN/WHEN/THEN format, non-functional requirements table, and a 6-week timeline
